content:
**Bloodied** is a first star weapon legendary mod in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Milepost Zero* update.

## Effects[]

When applied to a legendary weapon, it provides a steadily increasing Damage bonus the lower the player's health.

| Max Health | Bonus Damage | 
| 5% | +95% | 
| 10% | +90% | 
| 15% | +85% | 
| 20% | +80% | 
| 25% | +75% | 
| 30% | +70% | 
| 35% | +65% | 
| 40% | +60% | 
| 45% | +55% | 
| 50% | +50% | 
| 55% | +45% | 
| 60% | +40% | 
| 65% | +35% | 
| 70% | +30% | 
| 75% | +25% | 
| 80% | +20% | 
| 85% | +15% | 
| 90% | +10% | 
| 95% | +5% |

## Locations[]

- Mod boxes have a 1.5% chance to be received from scrapping a Bloodied legendary item.
- Can be crafted at a tinker's workbench once learned.
 - Crafting has a 1% chance to be unlocked from scrapping a Bloodied legendary item.
- Can be applied to gear at a weapons workbench.
